title: Effect
description: How content changes the character, and when. Effects apply while the content carrying them is active on the character and `when` is true. Fixed order per field: the field's own formula, then set, add, multiply, atLeast/atMost.

id.description: Optional ID, unique within the content item, so apps and rules issues can point at this effect.

op.description: One of the fixed effect operations. Kept in sync with `data/effect-operations.json`.

value.description: A formula for add/set/multiply/atLeast/atMost (on rolls and on incoming changes, `add` accepts dice: `1d4`; on rolls, `atLeast` and `atMost` take an integer and bound the roll's total after the dice); a grant value object for grant; a roll modifier for rollModifier; an option for option; changes for a tagged changes step for changes. On a roll's parts, `set` takes a formula (dice or a number) that replaces each matching part.

when.description: Condition for the effect to be active. `self` is the character's copy of the item carrying it. For `option`, the added option is offered only while this holds; it also sees the action context and `action`. For `changes`, the changes are added only while this holds, with the same context and `participant` in an `each` step. On an incoming target, it also sees `incoming`.

stackKey.description: Effects sharing a stack key on the same target are combined by the game's stacking policy for that key. The reserved value `source` means the content item the effect comes from (5E: two Blesses don't stack). Any other value is a literal key (orc-2e: `item`, `status`, `circumstance`). On a choice step, `option` effects sharing a key add only the first of them, in instance order, whatever the stacking policy.

rounding.description: Overrides the game's rounding for this effect's multiply.

duration.description: Informational only. Time tracking is the app's job; the engine never ends an effect by itself.

tags.description: Rolls with op `add` only: tags for the roll item the effect adds (Flame Tongue's `damage.fire`). Entries may be formulas.

multiplied.description: Rolls with op `add` only: `false` leaves the roll items the effect adds, dice or flat, alone when `multiplyDice` multiplies the roll's dice or `multiply` its items (5E's Savage Attacks: an extra die rolled once on a critical hit, not doubled; orc-2e's deadly die, added after doubling). Default `true`.

then.description: Incoming-change and roll effects only: changes to the effect's own entry once it counted. On an incoming-change effect, applyChanges applies them right after the adjust is routed, when the effect counted (its `when` held and stacking kept it); on a roll effect, the action proposes them `to: self` after the roll step, once, when the effect changed the roll (effects.md, "Roll effects that end themselves"). The entry is `self`: the copy for a `holder` effect, the applied entry for an `applied` one (for content an applied grant reaches, the granting entry). Each is a `setState` or `adjustState` with `entry: self`, which changes the state `self` reads the key from (for picked or held granted content that declares the key, its pick's state or its grant's saved state; otherwise the entry's, for picked or granted content the owning copy's), or with `pick: owner` or `grant: owner`, the pick or holder grant that activated the effect's content; their `value` and `by` are formulas seeing `item`, `self` and `incoming` (on a roll effect, the roll effect's context). On an `applied` effect, a `removeEffect` with `entry: self` ends the entry (a ward that triggers once, a condition that lasts one roll). Only for effects with an entry: on the rules' effects, a situational choice's and choice effects it is a load error (`then-without-copy`).

scope.description: Who the effect applies to. `holder` (default): a character who has the content active (features, inventory, picks, grants). `applied`: a character the content is applied to (its `applied` list: cast on them, a condition). Content in `applied` runs only its `applied` effects; held content runs only its `holder` effects.

multipliedOps.description: `multiplied` is only for `add` effects on rolls (not on a roll tally).

thenTarget.description: `then` is only for incoming-change and roll effects, and only an `applied` effect's may remove its entry.

thenChange.description: A change an incoming-change or roll effect makes after it counted: `setState` with `value`, `adjustState` with `by`, or `removeEffect` (an `applied` effect only, `entry: self`). It names `entry: self` (the state the effect's `self` reads the key from), `pick: owner` (the pick that activated the effect's content) or `grant: owner` (the holder grant that did).

pick.description: setState and adjustState: `owner`, the pick that activated the effect's content, whose state changes. Content that isn't picked has none: `unknown-reference`.

grant.description: setState and adjustState: `owner`, the holder grant that activated the effect's content, whose saved state changes. Content no holder grant activates has none: `unknown-reference`.

tallyOps.description: An effect on a roll tally uses add, atLeast or atMost.

choiceOps.description: `option` is the only op on a choice target.

stepOps.description: `changes` is the only op on a step target.

stepTarget.description: Changes steps of actions as they run, by tag. Only op `changes`.

steps.description: Changes step tags; the effect adds its changes to a step carrying any of them (a tag matches itself and every tag below it; tags an `action` step adds count).

from.description: `self`: only changes steps of actions made by the item carrying this effect. `any` (default): every matching changes step the character's actions reach.

stepChanges.description: What a `changes` effect adds to a tagged changes step: `changes`, proposed after the step's own each time the step runs (per participant in an `each` step) while the effect's `when` holds, `to` this `to`, else the step's. In its `when` and `changes`, `item` and `self` are the content carrying the effect (`entry: self` is that copy), the action's own are `action.item`, `action.self` and `action.step`, and the action's `params`, `situational`, `steps`, `flags`, `participants` (and `participant` in an `each` step) are bound.

to.description: Who the changes are for, as a `changes` step's `to`. Default: the step's `to`.

target.description: A character field (by ID, or a string formula giving one), a set of fields (by a static query over their tags), rolls as they happen (by tag), incoming changes (by field and tag), an action's choice steps (by tag), or an action's changes steps (by tag).

choiceTarget.description: Choice steps of actions as they run, by tag. Only op `option`.

choices.description: Choice step tags; the effect adds its option to a step carrying any of them (a tag matches itself and every tag below it).

from.description: `self`: only choice steps of actions made by the item carrying this effect. `any` (default): every matching choice step the character's actions reach.

option.description: An option an `option` effect adds to a choice step. Its ID is `<content id>#<id>`, named by `<content id>.options.<id>.name`; the effect's `when` is its condition. When it is picked, its `flags` are set, then its `changes`, if any, are resolved like a `changes` step's at the choice step's path, before the step's own `changes`; without them the pick is only recorded, for later steps to read (`steps.<id>.picked`). In its `when` and `changes`, `item` and `self` are the content carrying the effect (`entry: self` is that copy), and the action's own are `action.item`, `action.self` and `action.step`.

to.description: Who the changes are for, as a `changes` step's `to`. Default `self`.

flags.description: Flags set when the option is picked, as a branch case's: each formula is evaluated in the option's context (`item` and `self` the content's, the action's as `action.*`, `picked` bound) and set as `flags.<name>`, in order, before the option's `changes`. A flag already set is replaced. The action must set each flag elsewhere, in a branch case or a written option: one it doesn't is `formula-error` (cause `unknown-name`) at load, and a value of another type `type-mismatch`.

rolls.description: Roll tags; the effect applies to a roll carrying any of them (a tag matches itself and every tag below it).

from.description: `self`: only rolls made by the item carrying this effect. `any` (default): every matching roll the character makes.

tally.description: A declared roll tally (`rollTallies`) the effect adds to instead of the roll's total. Ops: `add`, `atLeast`, `atMost`, with an integer value. Without it, `atLeast` and `atMost` bound the roll's total once it is rolled.

parts.description: The roll's own parts, by tag: the effect reaches the items built from the action's parts (not those effects add) whose tags match. Only op `set` (replace the part) and the roll modifiers `stepDie`, `setFaces`, and `advantage` and `disadvantage` with `of: roll` (roll the matching parts again as a group, keeping the better or worse subtotal). Not with `tally`.

incoming.description: Changes about to be applied to this character (an `adjust` change with tags, e.g. damage). The effect modifies the change's amount before it is applied. Its `when`, `value` and `then` see `incoming`: the adjust's requested `amount`, its `field` and its `tags`. They also see `situational`: the receiving player's choices on the change, defaults for the rest.

grantValue.description: What a grant adds to a `set` field. Exactly one of: `item` (a content reference, e.g. a weapon proficiency or an action-granting feature), `tag`, `field` (a field ID), `query` (every match), or `formula` (a computed member, e.g. `pick.id` in a choice's effects).

rollModifier.description: A change to how a roll is made. Kinds are a fixed set kept in sync with `data/roll-modifiers.json`.

below.description: reroll: reroll faces at or below this value.

once.description: reroll: reroll at most once per die.

factor.description: multiplyDice: multiply the dice count of every dice item in the roll. multiply: multiply the value of every rolled item, dice and flat, before the roll's bounds, rounding an integer result. Both leave items marked `multiplied: false` alone.

value.description: minimumFace: treat lower faces as this value.

at.description: explode: explode on faces at or above this value (default: the highest face).

count.description: poolDice: how many dice to add to the pool (a formula). reroll: at most this many dice matching `below` are rerolled, lowest faces first (earliest first among equal faces); an integer formula. Default: every matching die.

part.description: poolDice: the roll part (by `id`) whose dice the new dice join. Default: the roll step's first dice part.

steps.description: stepDie: how many steps along d4, d6, d8, d10, d12 each matching die moves (negative for smaller); an integer formula.

of.description: advantage, disadvantage: `die` (default) rolls extra dice for the roll's main dice item and keeps the better or worse ones; `roll` makes the whole roll again and keeps the better or worse total. One counted source of the kind that applies with `roll` makes every extra a whole roll. On a `parts` target, `roll` is required: the matching parts' items are rolled again as a group and the better or worse total kept, the roll's other items rolled once.

faces.description: setFaces: the dice item's first faces, as integer formulas, used instead of asking for them.

fieldsTarget.description: A set of fields: every `integer` and `decimal` field of the ruleset whose view matches `where`, resolved once by loadRuleset (homebrew fields included). The effect is one instance per matching field, in field order, each exactly as if written with that field as its `target`, so it stacks, competes and is listed per field. Ops: add, multiply, atLeast, atMost; or `grant`, which matches every `set` field instead.

where.description: A condition over each field's view as `item`: `id` (qualified), `type` and `tags`. It may read nothing else (`unknown-name` at load), so the set is fixed: `'attr.dex' in item.tags`.

formulaTarget.description: One field, named by a string formula evaluated as an activation condition when the effect becomes active: `self`, `item`, `pick` and `slot` where bound, the character functions, the owner's picks, and input fields only (`'skills.lore.' + pick.value + '.granted'`). A local ID resolves in the effect's pack. The effect is then exactly as if written with that field as its `target`. An empty string targets nothing; a value naming no field is a sheet error (`unknown-field`), as is a field whose type the op doesn't take (`type-mismatch`). Ops: add, set, multiply, atLeast, atMost, grant.

fieldsOps.description: An effect on a set of fields uses add, multiply, atLeast or atMost, or grant into set fields.

partsOps.description: An effect on a roll's parts uses `set`, or a `stepDie`, `setFaces`, `advantage` or `disadvantage` roll modifier, and has no tally. Advantage and disadvantage there say `of: roll`: the matching parts are rolled again as a group.

rollSet.description: `set` on rolls replaces a roll's part, so its target names the parts.
